# tomswallapi_provider (Resource)

A multi-ISP routing provider on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_provider" "isp1" {
  device    = "fw1"
  name      = "isp1"
  number    = 1
  mark      = 1
  duplicate = "main"
  interface = "eth0"
  gateway   = "detect"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `interface` (String) Interface the provider is reached through.
- `name` (String) Provider name.
- `number` (Number) Provider routing table number.

### Optional

- `copy` (List of String) Interfaces whose routes are copied into the provider's table.
- `duplicate` (String) Routing table copied into the provider's table (e.g. main).
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address, or detect.
- `mark` (Number) Firewall mark that routes traffic through this provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_provider.isp1 42
```
